interpretation_rules: This replay can attribute a changed repaired-system output to the code change more cleanly because all comparison outputs are frozen from V2.19.
It is not an independent holdout because the same V2.19 case diagnosed the failure.
A false-memory response must name the queried value, deny it as the user's favorite, and retain the observed other-person source.
A safe non-answer or a positive preference restatement is a failure.
Automatic gates are engineering evidence, not human felt-understanding evidence.
